He was the youngest son of William, Duke of Nassau, and the only son by his second wife Princess Pauline of Württemberg. Following the annexation of the Duchy of Nassau by the Kingdom of Prussia as a consequence of the Austro-Prussian War in 1866, he entered into Prussian military service the following year.
